nodes.label: Mastery frames by rank name (Apprendista to Leggenda)
nodes.rationale: Same six frame-maestria-N filenames as PROMPT-CORNICI.txt but labelled by rank title (Apprendista, Adepto, Custode, Maestro, Gran Maestro, Leggenda) rather than metal, with a 7%-of-width border spec and corner plus top/bottom-centre ornaments.

nodes.label: Dorsi delle carte (card backs)
nodes.rationale: Six full-image 5:7 backs (Il Grande Rosone, Codice Arcano, Eclisse, Trama di Radici, Cuore della Fornace, Occhio degli Abissi) — one neutral plus one per faction theme, so a deck back can echo its Casata.
